final_candidates.decision_summary: Lys to Ile may improve hydrophobic packing in the HA2 coiled-coil, likely increasing folding stability. Charge loss creates some uncertainty for local electrostatics and cell-entry function.
Gly to Ala may increase helical propensity and stabilize the local structure. Slight concern remains about reduced fusion-related conformational flexibility.
Thr to Ile adds hydrophobic bulk and may improve core packing in the HA2 region. Loss of the polar Thr side chain is a moderate risk for stability and function.

stop_reason.detail: Further iterative self-review is unlikely to improve the Top-3 without external structural or experimental evidence.
